(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix Fleet Management configuration group: the OpenTelemetry Collector configurations that matching agents receive. Its family is either `raw` (collector configurations you write) or `preset` (generated from a configuration template). Destroy archives the group. **Note:** This resource is in Beta stage.
archived  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Whether this configuration group is archived.
description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Description of the group's purpose.
family  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Latest configuration family of the group.
family.active  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Whether this family is eligible for delivery to matching agents. This is not confirmation that an agent has applied it.
family.based_on_configuration_family_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration family UUID v7 this family is based on.
family.description  tftypes.String computed
    description: Human-readable description.
family.id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration family UUID v7.
family.last_activated_at  tftypes.String computed
    description: Time when this family was last activated.
family.preset  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Configuration template settings; present when the family has a chartName and observability features.
family.preset.chart_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration template type: `chart_name_otel_integration` for Kubernetes, `chart_name_otel_ecs_ec2` for ECS on EC2, or `chart_name_otel_linux_standalone`, `chart_name_otel_windows_standalone`, or `chart_name_otel_macos_standalone` for hosts.
family.preset.chart_version  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration template version. It determines the OTel Collector version, the generated collector configuration, and which integrationVersion values are supported. Unsupported versions are rejected.
family.preset.collector_version  tftypes.String computed
    description: OTel Collector semantic version Coralogix derived from chartVersion, without a leading v prefix.
family.preset.integration_version  tftypes.String computed
    description: Version of the observability features format used for this configuration family.
family.preset.metadata  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Environment setup values for the configuration template, such as ClusterName, KubernetesRunningOn, ApplicationName, or SubsystemName. Example: `{"ClusterName":"production-eu2"}`.
family.preset.observability_features  tftypes.String computed
    description: Observability feature settings for the configuration template, as a JSON object string; the available features depend on chartName and integrationVersion. Example: `{"logs":{"enabled":true}}`.
family.preset.remote_configurations  nested LIST computed
    description: Remote configurations Coralogix generated from the configuration template settings.
family.preset.remote_configurations.agent_selector  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Flat agent attributes that match agents for this configuration.
family.preset.remote_configurations.agent_selector.attributes  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Attributes of the stored selector. A remote configuration saved with an omitted or empty selector is returned without agentSelector, so the empty match-all selection is preserved; attributes are not expanded to the currently matched agents. Example: `{"cx.agent.type":"docker","host.name":"collector-host-01","service.version":"0.160.0"}`.
family.preset.remote_configurations.created_at  tftypes.String computed
    description: Time when this remote configuration was created.
family.preset.remote_configurations.hash  tftypes.String computed
    description: SHA-256 hash of the normalized raw configuration content.
family.preset.remote_configurations.id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Remote configuration UUID v7.
family.preset.remote_configurations.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Remote configuration name.
family.preset.remote_configurations.raw_configuration  tftypes.String computed
    description: Collector YAML sent to matching agents.
family.preset.remote_configurations.updated_at  tftypes.String computed
    description: Time when this remote configuration was last updated.
family.raw  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Inputs of a configuration family defined directly by its remote configurations; present when the family has no chartName.
family.raw.collector_version  tftypes.String computed
    description: Collector semantic version targeted by this family. This is separate from the family version and the Supervisor image tag.
family.raw.metadata  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Metadata stored with this configuration family. Example: `{"team":"platform"}`.
family.raw.remote_configurations  nested LIST computed
    description: Remote configurations of this configuration family.
family.raw.remote_configurations.agent_selector  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Flat agent attributes that match agents for this configuration.
family.raw.remote_configurations.agent_selector.attributes  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Attributes of the stored selector. A remote configuration saved with an omitted or empty selector is returned without agentSelector, so the empty match-all selection is preserved; attributes are not expanded to the currently matched agents. Example: `{"cx.agent.type":"docker","host.name":"collector-host-01","service.version":"0.160.0"}`.
family.raw.remote_configurations.created_at  tftypes.String computed
    description: Time when this remote configuration was created.
family.raw.remote_configurations.hash  tftypes.String computed
    description: SHA-256 hash of the normalized raw configuration content.
family.raw.remote_configurations.id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Remote configuration UUID v7.
family.raw.remote_configurations.name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Remote configuration name.
family.raw.remote_configurations.raw_configuration  tftypes.String computed
    description: Collector YAML sent to matching agents.
family.raw.remote_configurations.updated_at  tftypes.String computed
    description: Time when this remote configuration was last updated.
family.sources  nested LIST computed
    description: Immutable inputs that produced this configuration family version.
family.sources.configuration_overlay  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Configuration overlay that produced this family version.
family.sources.configuration_overlay.overlay_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration overlay UUID v7.
family.sources.configuration_overlay.overlay_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration overlay name at read time.
family.sources.configuration_overlay.overlay_version_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Configuration overlay version UUID v7.
family.version  tftypes.String computed
    description: Increasing family version within this group, returned as a string. The initial version is "1"; changed configuration content creates a new version.
id  tftypes.String required
    description: Configuration group UUID v7.
name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Display name shown in Fleet Management, unique among the team's configuration groups.
priority_order  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Selection priority when multiple configurations match an agent. Higher values take precedence.
tags  tftypes.List[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Tags for organizing the group. Tags do not select agents.
